journey.name: Signup — nothing is spent before Pubky Ring is there
journey.description:
The gate that keeps a user from paying for something they cannot use. Every signup method ends in a single-use token only Pubky Ring can redeem, so with Ring missing the flow must refuse to ask Homegate for anything at all — not an SMS, not an invoice, not even the availability probe that quotes the Lightning price.
Ring is *disabled* rather than uninstalled on purpose: uninstalling destroys the keys of the test accounts on the device.

actions.action: Disable Ring without removing it: adb shell pm disable-user --user 0 to.pubky.ring
Verify "signup_ring_required" is present and reads "First, install Pubky Ring"
Verify BOTH method cards read "Needs Pubky Ring" in place of a price — "signup_method_lightning_price" must NOT show a sats figure, because a figure could only have come from Homegate
Verify logcat shows "load: Pubky Ring is not installed — not minting a token that cannot be spent", and no Homegate request
Tap "signup_method_sms", then "signup_method_invite", and verify the screen does not move — both lead to a screen that mints a token on entry
THE UNBLOCK. Press home, re-enable Ring (adb shell pm enable to.pubky.ring), then bring Loopky back to the front
Verify the install block is gone and "signup_method_lightning_price" now quotes sats — the resume is what released the first Homegate call
Restore the device: adb shell pm enable to.pubky.ring (if not already done)
